title: supabase.com/pricing.md
snippet:
Supabase offers four plans: Free, Pro, Team, and Enterprise. All plans include unlimited API requests. Projects on paid plans aren't paused for inactivity.

Pro and Team plans include $10/month in compute credits, which covers one Micro instance. Additional projects each add their own compute cost. For example, a Pro org with 2 projects on Micro compute costs: $25 (plan) + $10 (project 1) + $10 (project 2) - $10 (credits) = $35/month.

- Free: $0/month, including 500 MB database size. Free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity.
Limit of 2 active projects.
- Pro: from $25/month, including 8 GB disk size per project and $10/month in compute credits that cover one project on Micro compute. A single database-only project on Micro compute costs $25/month before usage beyond the included quotas.
- Projects on paid plans are not paused for inactivity.

title: Supabase Free Tier Limits 2026: Projects, Pausing, Storage and Egress
snippet:
As of Oct 26, 2026, Supabase has a $0 Free plan, Pro from $25/month, Team from $599/month and custom Enterprise. Paid plans add usage charges above included quotas.

> **Quick answer:** Supabase free tier limits, as of Oct 26, 2026: 2 active projects, a 500 MB database, 1 GB of file storage, 5 GB of egress plus 5 GB cached, 50,000 monthly active users and 500,000 Edge Function invocations. Free projects pause after a week of inactivity. Pro starts at $25 a month when you outgrow them.
**How much does Supabase cost?** Supabase pricing starts with a $0 Free plan. As of Oct 26, 2026, Pro starts at $25 a month, Team at $599 and Enterprise is custom, and paid plans add usage charges once you pass the included quotas.

**Supabase pricing has a free plan, then a paid plan per organization plus usage-based charges. Each plan includes quotas for things like egress, storage and monthly active users. Stay inside them and you pay the plan price; go over on Pro and you pay per unit for the extra. Compute is billed separately.**

**As of Oct 26, 2026, Supabase lists four plans: Free at $0 a month, Pro from $25 a month, Team from $599 a month and Enterprise at a custom price. Pro and Team include the first project, with more projects from $10 a month. Usage above each plan's quotas is billed on top.**
| Plan | Monthly price (as of Oct 26, 2026) | Key limits listed | Good for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | 500 MB database, 5 GB egress, 1 GB files, 50,000 MAU, 2 active projects, pauses after 1 week inactive | Learning, prototypes, side projects |
| Pro | From $25 ("First project included. Additional projects from $10/mo.") | 100,000 MAU, 8 GB disk per project, 250 GB egress, 100 GB files, then usage pricing; never paused | Launched apps with real users |
| Team | From $599 | Everything in Pro plus team features listed on the page; never paused | Companies that need team controls |
| Enterprise | Custom | Set with Supabase | Large workloads |
